lines.t: Fist to the mirror, I shatter reflections in the glass
Egos screaming loud, but the spirit checking me fast
Chase golden shadows left my soul in the ash
Heart heavy, pride's anchor dragging me past
Pain ain't a stranger, walk with me in my steps
Temptation, whisper secrets, left my mind in a mess
Chains on my wrist, but the key in the text
For my demons with a sword, but the wound still pressed
Pages stained with tears, can't erase my past
But I hear them whispering, this storm won't last
You call me beloved, though I'm stained and torn
Your grace like a river through my nights reborn
Unshaken, unbroken, love forever swore
Your light cuts the dark, my shelter in the storm
Streets taught survival, a game with no rules
Taught to drown out the truth with liquor and jewels
But the flash fades quick and the void still pulls
Yahushua called me home, broke the devil's tools
Pride is a poison, I drank it like wine
Tried to build my own kingdom, left me deaf to the divine
Carried burdens on my shoulders, thought they were mine
But he took them to the cross, broke the chains in time
